Our services

Everything we do to help you furnish your home with confidence.

Countrywide delivery

We deliver from Eldoret to all 47 counties. Your delivery fee is shown at checkout based on your county.

Pay with M-Pesa

Pay safely from your phone. You approve the payment prompt with your PIN and get a receipt.

Assembly and installation

Our team can assemble your beds, wardrobes and cabinets so they are ready to use on delivery day.

Custom-made furniture

Want a different size, wood or colour? Tell us your idea and we will quote you for a made-to-order piece.

Room planning advice

Not sure what fits? Send us your room size and photos on WhatsApp and we will suggest pieces and layouts.

Bulk and office orders

Furnishing a rental, hotel, school or office? Ask us about special prices for larger orders.

Store pickup

Prefer to collect? Pick up your order from our shop in Eldoret and see the furniture in person.

After-sales support

Have a problem with your furniture? Call or WhatsApp us and we will help you quickly.

About Pam's Furniture Shop

Pam's Furniture Shop is an Eldoret furniture shop that equips Kenyan homes from the bedroom to the kitchen. We sell classic designs that last, with a modern finish.

Every piece is checked before it leaves our shop, and we deliver countrywide. You pay by M-Pesa only, so every payment is quick and traceable.

What we stand for

Honest prices in Kenyan shillings.
Quality materials and careful finishing.
Clear delivery and friendly after-sales help.
